entries.2ecfccf537f575db: "BUYMA" is a CtoC marketplace where users can purchase fashion items from around the world from more than 240,000 personal shoppers (sellers) residing in 185 countries and regions. Because sellers purchase items after an order is placed, they hold no inventory risk, and buyers can find the latest local items and items cheaper than in Japan. As of January 2026, the number of members was approximately 12.01 million, and revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥5,373 million. The company's head office (Minato-ku, Tokyo) is the base of this business.
